current_difficulty_reason: The known rational-fibration alternative does not bound a finitely generated algebraic subgroup preserving a fibration, because its elements may affect different fibers. The authors identify the Jonquieres complex with a restricted product of fiber trees and prove that purely elliptic finite-generation actions fix a common point, controlling persistent fibers in both abelian and semisimple north-south cases. That new fixed-point core supplies boundedness after the classical Cremona and local-field prerequisites, beyond merely applying the fibration classification.
